div.head: I Cn 5.2c
div.ab: ⁊ gyf he sig mægleas, ladige mid geferan oððe on fæsten fó, gif he þæt þurfe, ⁊ ga to corsnæde ⁊ þæræt gefare, swa swa God ræde.
And gif hi is mægleas, ladige hine mid geferan oððe on fæsten fó, gif he þæt þurfe, ⁊ ga to corsnæde ⁊ þæræt gefære, swa swa Godd ræde.
Si parentes non habeat, cum sociis se purget uel ieiunium ineat, si opus sit, et applicetur ad corsnéd, et fiat inde uoluntas Dei.
⁊ gyf he sig mægleas, ladige mid geferan oððe on fæsten fó, gif he þæt þurfe, ⁊ ga to corsnæde ⁊ þæræt gefare swa swa God ræde.

And if he has no kindred, he shall clear himself with the help of his fellow-ecclesiastics, or have recourse to fasting, if he must, and go to the ordeal of consecrated bread, and experience there what God shall decree.

Und wenn er ohne Sippe ist, schwöre er sich mit Genossen rein oder, wenn er das muss, fang er Fasten an und schreite zum Entscheidungsbissen und erfahre dabei [d. h. leide] so, wie Gott bestimmen mag.
And if he is without kin, let him clear himself with his fellows, or, if he must, begin a fast and go to the consecrated morsel, and experience [i.e. suffer] there as God may decree.
